resources.string: Applies to the output audio is going to right now. If it sounds AFTER the other devices (a Bluetooth speaker, for example), raise the value; if it sounds BEFORE, lower it. The device speaker and each Bluetooth speaker keep their own value. Changes apply at once, even in a room.
Measures the real delay of this output (a Bluetooth speaker, for example) with a brief tone. It also runs by itself inside a room.
Could not measure. Put the device near its speaker, raise the volume a little and try again.
Without the microphone the delay cannot be measured; the adjustment below stays manual.
